name: youtube-mcp
description: Search YouTube, manage your channel and read your analytics. Changes to your channel and content are previewed and need your approval first; viewer actions need explicit confirmation.

settings.name: YouTube Data API key
settings.description: Your YouTube Data API v3 key. Enough for the public tools.

settings.name: OAuth client JSON path
settings.description: Absolute path to the Desktop OAuth client JSON. Needed for your channel's tools (playlists, uploads, captions, comments, analytics).

settings.name: Profile name
settings.description: A name you choose, for example creator-main. Needed for your channel's tools (playlists, uploads, captions, comments, analytics).

settings.name: Channel ID
settings.description: Your YouTube channel ID, starting with UC. Needed for your channel's tools (playlists, uploads, captions, comments, analytics).

settings.name: State directory
settings.description: Where local state (OAuth token, approvals, local history database) lives. Leave empty to use ~/.youtube-mcp.
